notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Firelookout.ca record gives no build year, tower type, elevation or status. The only history found is one towerman's entry on websiteservice.ca, which lists Clarke among four towers. The entry reads 'Sam was relief for his dad in 1981'; the story does not name the father, since the list does not say who he was. A separate note on the list, under Richard Sevigny, says after mid-August 2001 'all towers condemmed, to be rebuilt', but it names other towers and not Clarke, so it is not used for Clarke's fate. The brief's local_unit is 'Division No. 18'; the record reads 'Division No. 18, Unorganized, SK', and the story uses the record's wording. Word count is under the about-120 target because the sources are thin.
